description: With an unknown predicate a failed splat over an object gives an unknown one-element tuple
notes: The spec passes an error in a result through only if that result is selected, and an unknown predicate selects neither, which is what hashicorp/hcl does. The spec doesn't say what type a result that failed contributes to the unified type: SplatExpr.Value (hclsyntax/expression.go) wraps an object source in a one-element tuple, and when the attribute access fails it returns an unknown tuple with the type the failed access gives, which unifies with [2].
